purpose: First unbiased estimate of the frozen V92 candidate. The spent panel (12 spent seeds) gave 24-0 vs V50, but those seeds were used during earlier V50-lineage development and the median margin was only +412. This holdout uses 12 seeds never used in any of the project's 6206 prior saved games.
no_edits_permitted: The candidate is frozen. No retune, no parameter change, no variant. Any edit invalidates this holdout.
seed_status: FRESH AND SEALED. Verified: each has 0 prior games across all experiments/**/games.jsonl (6206 games, 704 distinct seeds). These are consumed by this holdout and must not be reused for further tuning.
seats: both ab and ba for every pairing
games: 48 (candidate vs V50, candidate vs V56) + 24 (frozen V50 control vs V56) = 72

predeclared_gate.zero_errors: candidate_errors + opponent_errors + infrastructure_errors + timeouts == 0 across all runs
predeclared_gate.no_score_rate_regression_vs_v56: candidate score_rate against V56 within 5 percentage points of the matched frozen V50 control score_rate against V56, same 12 seeds, both seats
predeclared_gate.on_pass: report to root. Root decides on the Kaggle submission.
predeclared_gate.on_fail: STOP. No retune, no rerun, no fresh seed, no variant iteration.

prior_evidence_for_context.note: the 24-0 is a real effect, not self-play, because the identical-policy null is 24 draws
